svg.title: Vague Prompt, Strong Brief
svg.desc: A vague one-line request compared with a strong brief whose lines are marked goal, context, audience, format and example; for technical tasks the brief adds the columns, a sample row, the rule and the exact error text.
svg.text: Same request; the strong one marks each part Claude can't guess.
Write something about our loyalty scheme.
no goal, reader, format or facts
Goal: a newsletter section that gets members to use points before 31 March.
Context: points expire 31 March; 2,000-point minimum; three new partner cafés.
Audience: existing members, not new sign-ups.
Format: 120 words, one heading, one call to action.
Columns, one sample row, the rule, the exact #VALUE! text
